description: Named principals available to any case via steps[].as. IDs are fixed UUIDv7 values so a fixture can reference them directly and so failures are readable.

contributors._note: Availability set but EXPIRED. Must be invisible to hirer search — ADR-0002.
Shares github_user_id with hirer 'dave_hiring'. Self-hire exclusion target — ADR-0002.

organizations.name: Acme Corp
organizations._note_workplace: ADR-0024 decisions 11-12. An office organisation with TWO live addresses, so a role can be onsite in two places and an address can be removed without touching the main office. Bound as {{acme.address.main}} and {{acme.address.austin}}.

organizations.name: Tiny Studio
organizations._note: Verified on identity but NOT on payment. Contact requests must carry the disclosure label — ADR-0002.
organizations._note_workplace: ADR-0024 decision 12: FULLY REMOTE. No address, adds none, posts no onsite entry until an administrator approves an office request.

organizations.name: Unknown Ltd
organizations._note_workplace: An office organisation with only its main office. Its address is the 'another organisation's address' a role at Acme must not be able to point at.

hirers._note_username: The sign-in identifier since ADR-0016. NOT NULL and unconditionally unique platform-wide, so it is seeded rather than derived.

hirers._note: Registered but NOT verified. May sign in; must not search, view a scorecard, or shortlist — ADR-0002.
hirers._note_role: Owner of the org they registered. Since ADR-0016 §4 only an owner may roster, and Pat is this organisation's only seat, a member here would leave an org that can never seat anyone.

hirers._note_username: Distinct from contributor 'dave': the two are separate account types that happen to share a GitHub identity, and a username is a hirer-namespace name.
hirers._note: Same github_user_id as contributor 'dave'. AssertNotSelf must exclude dave from every result this hirer sees.
